text.1e32f5668a03.zh: 抱歉,无法删除已分配任务的插件。

text.811fbf9b7d4e.en: The new plugin was created successfully.

text.96f62db1f9d1.en: Could not locate Plugin with ID:
text.96f62db1f9d1.zh: 找不到指定 ID 的插件：

text.f225bbb348cf.en: The internal Plugin ID used for API calls.  This cannot be changed.
text.f225bbb348cf.zh: 供 API 调用使用的内部插件 ID，不可修改。

text.9a08deca64ef.en: Enter a name for the Plugin.  Ideally it should be somewhat short, and Title Case.
text.9a08deca64ef.zh: 输入简短、易于识别的插件名称。

text.acfc1e7a66d0.en: Select whether events using this Plugin should be enabled or disabled in the schedule.
text.acfc1e7a66d0.zh: 选择使用此插件的计划任务是否允许调度。

text.0f7af1e10c33.en: Enter an ID for the parameter, which will be the JSON key.
text.0f7af1e10c33.zh: 输入参数 ID，将作为 JSON 键。

text.2d0f4b132415.en: Enter a label, which will be displayed next to the control.
text.2d0f4b132415.zh: 输入标签，显示在控件旁边。

text.6834c4992887.en: That parameter ID is already taken.  Please enter a unique value.
text.6834c4992887.zh: 该参数 ID 已被占用，请输入唯一的值。

text.8512b1354ba2.en: Enter the size of the text field, in characters.
text.8512b1354ba2.zh: 输入文本字段的大小，以字符计。

text.f29243671c6c.en: Enter the default value for the text field.
text.f29243671c6c.zh: 输入文本字段的默认值。

text.8f619b75b07a.en: Enter the number of visible rows to allocate for the text box.
text.8f619b75b07a.zh: 输入文本框分配的可显示行数。

text.0c385937e69d.en: Optionally enter default text for the text box.
text.0c385937e69d.zh: 可选，输入文本框的默认文本。

text.d70172baf7f9.en: Select whether the checkbox should be initially checked or unchecked.
text.d70172baf7f9.zh: 选择复选框初始为选中还是未选中。

text.e6b68a9ce2b1.en: Enter the value for the hidden field.

text.86991cea74cc.en: Enter a comma-separated list of items for the menu.
text.86991cea74cc.zh: 输入逗号分隔的菜单项列表。

text.912df727f1f7.en: Optionally enter an item to be selected by default.
text.912df727f1f7.zh: 可选，输入默认选中的项。

text.40fef7b51231.en: Please enter an ID for the plugin parameter.
text.40fef7b51231.zh: 请输入插件参数的 ID。

text.61fcfa763c48.en: The parameter ID needs to be alphanumeric.
text.61fcfa763c48.zh: 参数 ID 必须为字母数字组合。

text.8a1c50d3557f.en: Please enter a label for the plugin parameter.
text.8a1c50d3557f.zh: 请输入插件参数的标签。

text.0a4068849867.en: Please enter a size for the text field.
text.0a4068849867.zh: 请输入文本字段的尺寸。

text.bc32e06eec2d.en: The text field size needs to be between 1 and 40 characters.
text.bc32e06eec2d.zh: 文本字段大小须在 1 到 40 个字符之间。

text.19205f6ba894.en: Please enter a number of rows for the text box.

text.3212e066d638.en: The text box rows needs to be between 1 and 50.
text.3212e066d638.zh: 文本框行数须在 1 到 50 之间。

text.d02eba280016.en: Please enter a comma-separated list of items for the menu.
text.d02eba280016.zh: 请输入逗号分隔的菜单项列表。

text.d8283e5c1525.en: The default value you entered was not found in the list of menu items.
text.d8283e5c1525.zh: 输入的默认值不在菜单项列表中。

text.6a026e02166b.en: Please enter a title for the Plugin.

text.26572bcc4f67.en: Please enter a filesystem path to the executable command for the Plugin.
text.26572bcc4f67.zh: 请输入插件可执行命令的文件系统路径。

text.a3f27defcce0.en: You must not include any newlines (EOLs) in your command.  Please consider using the built-in Shell Plugin.
text.a3f27defcce0.zh: 命令不能包含换行。需要多行脚本时，请使用内置 Shell 插件。

text.971ea7e23308.en: Are you sure you want to remove the server

text.4b63c686e0d0.en: Are you sure you want to delete the server group

text.8e73fea8a409.en: Are you sure you want to restart the server

text.602891e70f1d.en: ?  All server jobs will be aborted.
text.602891e70f1d.zh: 吗？该服务器上的所有执行实例都会被中止。

text.fd273a3bca54.en: Are you sure you want to shutdown the server

text.f50cbe414cd1.en: Enter the hostname or IP of the server you want to add.
text.f50cbe414cd1.zh: 输入要添加的服务器的主机名或 IP。

text.9143e470ce3e.en: Please enter a server hostname or IP address.
text.9143e470ce3e.zh: 请输入服务器主机名或 IP 地址。

text.2faf07877c1f.en: Please enter a valid server hostname or IP address.
text.2faf07877c1f.zh: 请输入有效的服务器主机名或 IP 地址。

text.c8a1cd985627.en: That server is already in the cluster.

text.66b146d1b3f0.en: Sorry, you cannot remove a server that has active jobs running on it.
text.66b146d1b3f0.zh: 抱歉,无法移除其上仍有作业运行的服务器。

text.bba7e48edf83.en: The internal Group ID used for API calls.  This cannot be changed.
text.bba7e48edf83.zh: 用于 API 调用的内部组 ID,不可更改。

text.74d18acb4235.en: Enter a title for the server group, short and sweet.
text.74d18acb4235.zh: 为服务器组输入一个简短好记的标题。

text.5376c6813cd4.en: Enter a regular expression to auto-assign servers to this group by their hostnames, e.g. "^mtx\d+\.".
text.5376c6813cd4.zh: 输入用于匹配主机名的正则表达式，匹配的服务器将自动归入此组。例如："^mtx\d+\."。

text.8dd20f70bef7.en: Select whether servers in the group are eligible to become the primary server, or run as workers only.
text.8dd20f70bef7.zh: 选择组内服务器是否允许成为主服务器，或仅用于执行任务。

text.5c61df72ebbb.en: Please enter a title for the server group.
text.5c61df72ebbb.zh: 请输入服务器组的标题。

text.a7a8c35423fc.en: Please enter a regular expression for the server group.
text.a7a8c35423fc.zh: 请输入服务器组的正则表达式。

text.5c479e07d4c5.en: Sorry, you cannot delete the last Primary Eligible server group.
text.5c479e07d4c5.zh: 抱歉,无法删除最后一个可作为主服务器的服务器组。

text.52591cdf6a6d.en: Sorry, you cannot delete a group that has events assigned to it.
text.52591cdf6a6d.zh: 抱歉,无法删除已分配任务的组。

text.a1e5c48a9bb5.en: Server is being restarted in the background.

text.2253cb7357d4.en: Server is being shut down in the background.

text.8ada4b5dd729.en: "?  There is no way to undo this action, and no way to recover the data.
text.8ada4b5dd729.zh: " 吗？此操作无法撤销，数据也无法恢复。

text.3fd9d10cde62.en: Users are managed by an external system, so you cannot add users from here.
text.3fd9d10cde62.zh: 用户由外部系统管理,无法从此处添加用户。

text.8e8a64956023.en: Select notification options for the new user.
text.8e8a64956023.zh: 为新用户选择通知选项。

text.be04db368228.en: Please enter a username for the new account.
text.be04db368228.zh: 请输入新账户的用户名。

text.252da34e1839.en: Please make sure the username contains only alphanumerics, periods and dashes.
text.252da34e1839.zh: 请确保用户名仅包含字母、数字、句点和连字符。

text.eb2face1856b.en: Please enter an e-mail address where the user can be reached.
text.eb2face1856b.zh: 请输入可以联系到该用户的电子邮箱地址。

text.bf6d7436bcfc.en: Please enter the user's first and last names.

text.4ac971eaed4b.en: Please enter a secure password to protect the account.
text.4ac971eaed4b.zh: 请输入安全密码以保护账户。

text.81b1cfea12d2.en: The new user account was created successfully.
text.81b1cfea12d2.zh: 新用户账户已成功创建。

text.7f886e96b840.en: Users are managed by an external system, so making changes here may have little effect.
text.7f886e96b840.zh: 用户由外部系统管理，此处的修改可能不会生效。

text.5d623730adba.en: Are you sure you want to delete the user account "

text.55e04e7b98a6.en: "?  Users are managed by an external system, so this will have little effect here.
text.55e04e7b98a6.zh: " 吗？用户由外部系统管理，此处的删除可能不会生效。

text.aebdf1cf5e70.en: Enter the username which identifies this account.  Once entered, it cannot be changed.
text.aebdf1cf5e70.zh: 输入用于标识此账户的用户名，创建后无法修改。

text.044e177b2a9b.en: 'Suspended' means that the account remains in the system, but the user cannot log in.
text.044e177b2a9b.zh: 停用后，账户仍保留在系统中，但用户无法登录。

text.dfed146cc948.en: User's first and last name.  They will not be shared with anyone outside the server.
text.dfed146cc948.zh: 用户姓名，不会共享给服务器之外的人员。

text.9c6e9963f255.en: This can be used to recover the password if the user forgets.  It will not be shared with anyone outside the server.
text.9c6e9963f255.zh: 用于找回密码，不会共享给服务器之外的人员。

text.b1ec3558e944.en: Optionally enter a new password here to reset it.  Please make it secure.
text.b1ec3558e944.zh: 可在此输入新密码以重置,请确保密码足够安全。

text.c9f6d01d35e7.en: Enter a password for the account.  Please make it secure.
text.c9f6d01d35e7.zh: 输入账户密码,请确保密码足够安全。

text.d8153b47de96.en: Select which privileges the user account should have. Administrators have all privileges.
text.d8153b47de96.zh: 选择此账户的权限。管理员拥有全部权限。

text.27e6854b22ca.en: Please select at least one category privilege.
text.27e6854b22ca.zh: 请至少选择一个分类权限。

text.824c5f5144be.en: Please select at least one server group privilege.
text.824c5f5144be.zh: 请至少选择一个服务器组权限。

text.2729c3583bef.en: The request timed out.  Please try again.

text.e6b89923744c.en: An unknown network error occurred.  Please try again.
text.e6b89923744c.zh: 发生未知网络错误，请重试。

text.ecadc17d178e.zh: 跳过 SSL 证书校验
